content:
Lilia Baker

I have been living on this island for what I think has been a year and a half. The ship I was on crashed into the rocky shore and I would have died if it wasn’t for a jackalope who saved me. (Played by <@!292531828592738304> ) Because of them, I was the sole survivor. We quickly became friends, I taught them common, while they helped me build my new home here. The uru took care of any bodies that washed up, and I collected things from the wreck, anything I could get. As I salvaged what I could, I remember being followed by a raven. Soon I realized it was the Raven Queen watching over me and I became her devout follower. While death brought me to this island, she helped me preserve my life. I'm interested in these newcomers, they seem to be from Europe like me. I didn’t talk to a lot of the natives here, I know a few, but I kept to myself mostly while I mourned my fellow passengers aboard that ship. It will be interesting to see who these people are, and what they are like. It has been quite some time since I have been in their society, the people here were kind and helped me, but I always missed home when I was with them. Maybe these newcomers brought a piece of my home here.

I’ve been on this Island for just over a year and a half. After the attack on and death of my brothers Cesario and Sebastian I burrowed away in fear for a very very very very (where was I again… right) very long time. Upon resurfacing on a beachy entrance to an island she heard saw a shipwreck with numerous bodies scattered, and a drowning lady among them. She swam into action to aid and save her <@!361351593292988425> a. Soon we quickly became friends and she taught me common and settle into a home. We avoided locals and kept to our little gathering. Viola is a very timid person and is still pretty iffy when it comes to common, often slipping into Coastal Aranian.  She is a Female Jackalope with white antlers and red fur patches integrated with the brown

Kevvoril, is the second son of his father Gorulo. And therefore unable to take the title once his father paces. However, rather than to stoop so low as to plot his brothers demise as he had heard occurs in other noble lineages. Instead he caught wind of some settlement. Some Roanoke. A colony that had been settled a few times and yet kept falling apart. Kevvoril saw this as his opportunity to take charge of something. If he could not claim his father's lineage then perhaps he can start his own.

**Selene summons their familiar Eselein**

A little beyond the soft ring of light cast by the near-spent candles can be heard the whispering crush of leaves and brushing of grass. A small child dances about in a flowing gown trimmed in flowers, embroidered or perhaps growing. The light slowly reveals a summoning. Pausing for a moment at the offering the dress-clad dancer scrunches a nose at the wine then places a small silver coin beside the bottle. More footfalls, rather the sound of hooves, herald a visitor. A donkey saunters in from the darkness. The child pauses their dance to show the animal the coin.
“Good likeness, I remember you then” the donkey says while inspecting the goat-legged drunkard depicted on the coin. The child goes back to dancing, pocketing the coin somewhere in the folds of their dress.

Selene appears rather young with the spotted complexion and ears of a fawn. Antlers grow when they shift and will sometimes shed between shifts. Shifting also sees bare feet become hooves as their lower half resembles that of a satyrs were it to be part deer rather than goat. With no voice they communicate in equal part magic and a signed form of thieves cant. They take a particularly gentle approach to bounty hunting as they charm or slumber those they pursue and ride them in on Eselein. They also specialize in finding all manor of odds and ends for those that can pay or just really need the help.

Who am I?  Why would you want to know me?  I am no adventurer.  No dark backstory, no orphanage, I had a loving family, and was never beaten.  My story is uninteresting, unlike the halfling that saved the world.  Did I ever tell you that story?  Well let me tell you, this halfling held a cursed ring of invisibility.  My favorite story of him was, as he was fleeing the undead lords that could detect the ring, he happened upon pit fiend in the depths of a dwarven city, deep in undermountian.

Oh how did I get here?  You didn't notice me on the ship?  Ah its the face.  Yeah I used other peoples faces each day.  you may not remember me, but I remember you in the observation lounge.  People don't pay much attention to the crew.  Anyway, I decided that I wanted to embrace the new life here.

Anyway, its nice to formally meet you.  What's your story?

(A faceless Changeling, often shifting its own features, when not specifically being somebody)

Sir Rockman, the indomitable Knight of Mello

Created by the engineer Ebuc, lost to the hatch. He was programed for defense, to strengthen the town. His soul had begun to resonate with a fellow colonist named Leaf, the nature cleric. After some brave advice from Wren, he decided to ask for her hand. He married Leaf at the château-de-léclipse. After events had unfolded, leading to the theft of 3 artifact and the baby god Mello herself, Rockman had become stricken with grief and remorse for his actions. Even though at the time he did not know that he was the one that had done the deed himself, he pleaded for mercy and forgiveness to the Deity Mello. Looking to his wife Leaf, he begged to be taken in under Mello's protection. Not knowing religion in the past week of his life's existence, he pledged himself to Mello in his wife's presence. His plea was heard, and sir Rockman the artificer had been mentally teleported to Mello's own realm. He laughed and played with a small girl in a field of flowers, his childlike soul refreshing his purity. Mello then gave him a choice, with a pinky-promise. The decision was made with his wife's faith to this deity in mind rather quickly. Mello had accepted his patronage and made him a paladin of her order. A protector of his wife and their faith.
